abstract: We construct a linear-size clean set beside a nearly classical no-three-in-line seed while excluding an entire class of mixed collinear triples. For arbitrarily large square side lengths $N$, there are a classical clean seed $S$ of size $(3/2-o(1))N$, its full modular hyperbola carrier $H$, and a clean set $J$ of size at least $c_*N$, for an absolute $c_*>0$, such that $J$ is disjoint from $H$ and every physical line through two points of $J$ misses $H$. In addition, no line through two points of $S$ and one point of $J$ has primitive direction height at most a constant multiple of $\sqrt{\log N}$. The proof couples an independently thinned arithmetic support to a random conic level and translation. Weighted physical inventories remove incidence triangles involving carrier-hit two-site blocks, including repeated modular residues. A growing quadratic-character sieve is then incorporated into joint source moments. Its conditional-incidence estimate permits mixed-capacity selection with an absolute linear output bound. Four fixed exact controllers accompany the algebraic and geometric interfaces. The union $S\cup J$ is not proved clean: high-height old/old/new conflicts remain. The result gives no profitable deletion mask, no improvement of the classical asymptotic density, and no unbounded family above $1.8N$.
